overloads.label: Records (cursor)
overloads.description: Returns one cursor page of records. Use this for loops, or any time you want pagination that's unaffected by records added or deleted mid-walk.

overloads.label: Distinct values (cursor)
overloads.description: Returns one cursor page of a single field's distinct values, always in ascending order. Use it to list the unique values of a field, for example to populate filter options or autocomplete.

overloads.label: Records (skip)
overloads.description: Returns an array of records. Kept for existing code. Prefer a cursor for pagination instead.

filter.leadIn: The `filter()` method has three forms. The query is always the first argument.

overloads.label: Records (cursor)
overloads.description: Returns one cursor page of matching records. Use this for loops, or any time you want pagination that's unaffected by records added or deleted mid-walk.

overloads.label: Distinct values (cursor)
overloads.description: Returns one cursor page of a single field's distinct values among matching records, always in ascending order. Use it to list the unique values of a field among matching records, for example to populate filter options or autocomplete.

overloads.label: Records (skip)
overloads.description: Returns an array of matching records. Kept for existing code. Prefer a cursor for pagination instead.
